widgets_values: A panoramic lens inside the space capsule is used, presenting a eye-level view that can show most of the space inside the capsule. In the frame, a monkey in a silver-white spacesuit is intently operating the buttons on the console; next to it, a giraffe, also in a spacesuit, uses its long neck to easily check the instrument panel at a high position; an elephant is securing a large experimental container with its sturdy legs, diligently conducting space experiments; a kangaroo places its joey into a specially made space baby capsule and is checking the life support system inside the capsule itself; there is also a penguin, gliding nimbly inside the capsule, responsible for delivering small experimental samples. Overall, the animals are portrayed as astronauts, creating a novel and busy space exploration scene inside the technologically advanced space capsule. Suspended in the middle of the frame is a huge three-dimensional "C" symbol with a glass-like texture, glowing. It is a smooth three-dimensional character with a metallic texture, and the metal shimmers with colorful halos, being a metal art piece that becomes the focal point of the frame.
